description: This file defines a functional interface `ThingPersistenceActorPropsFactory` that provides a method to create Akka actor Props for a thing-persistence actor, given a ThingId and DistributedPub access for event publishing.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActorPropsFactory
classes.description: A functional interface for creating Props for a thing-persistence-actor based on a ThingId and DistributedPub.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns an Akka Props object for the thing-persistence-actor, configured with the provided ThingId and DistributedPub instance.
